## MindElixir.historyStack property

Shared undo/redo journal, created by the operation-history plugin during `init` (when `allowUndo` is enabled). Pass it to another document — e.g. an Outliner — so both interleave on ONE undo/redo timeline. Available after `init` resolves.

**Signature:**

```typescript
historyStack?: HistoryStack;
```
